Title: Germany – Planting and maintenance services of green areas – Planting of Seagrass for Ostwind 3 Offshore project between KP18.1-18.4
Procedure title: Planting of Seagrass for Ostwind 3 Offshore project between KP18.1-18.4
Description: The main target for this operation is the planting of seagrass, either as a single plant or/and as a rope consisting plants. Employer is requesting the Bidder to submit a quotation for the execution of seagrass planting works. Es wird ausschließlich eine Lieferung von elektrischer Energie aus erneuerbaren Energien (Grünstrom) abgenommen. Der gelieferte Strom muss hierbei bilanziell zu 100 % aus erneuerbaren Energien stammen.
